caption: The drawing depicts an object composed of a central vertical wooden pole with a decorative finial at the top and an ornate, turned design in the middle, supported at the base by three elegantly curved legs. Affixed near the top to the pole is a large, square panel with a blue background decorated with a repeating floral pattern featuring cream or beige stylized flowers and light green leaves and stems. The wooden elements are a medium brown color with visible grain, and the blue panel is framed with a narrow brown border matching the pole and legs. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored.
title: Fire Screen
